privacy:
Metri Guard processes packaging images solely for automated compliance analysis under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009. 

1. Data Processing
Images uploaded by users are processed in memory and immediately discarded after the compliance audit is generated, unless explicitly opted-in for AI model training. 

2. Data Sharing
We do not share any vendor or package data with third parties. Findings generated by this tool are for decision support only and are strictly confidential between the authorized user and the system.
terms:
Metri Guard provides AI-driven decision-support tools for packaging compliance.

1. Disclaimer of Liability
Our automated findings do not constitute binding legal advice. All results, notices, and penalty references must be manually verified by an authorized Legal Metrology Officer before any enforcement action is taken.

2. Usage
By using this tool, you agree to upload only relevant packaging materials and to not use the system for unauthorized surveillance.
